title: Find Local Maxima
text: Find local maxima in matrices, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Count output data type} sets Data type for number of local maximums; {Maximum number of local maxima}, {Neighborhood size} sets the size of neighborhood region, {Source of threshold value} sets the source to enter the threshold value Specify via, {Threshold}, {Input is Hough matrix spanning full theta range} sets the whether input is a Hough matrix, {Index output data type} sets the data type for coordinates of local maximums and {Output variable size signal} sets the support input signals of varying length. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Th
ports.summary: Threshold for detecting local maxima scalar

ports.name: Idx
ports.summary: Coordinates of local maxima P -by-2 matrix

params.name: Maximum number of local maxima
params.values: Maximum number of local maxima to detect 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Neighborhood size
params.values: Size of neighborhood region [ 5 7 ] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Source of threshold value
params.values: Source to enter the threshold value Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Threshold
params.values: Threshold for detecting local maxima 10 (default) | scalar

params.name: Input is Hough matrix spanning full theta range
params.values: Whether input is a Hough matrix off (default) | on

params.name: Index output data type
params.values: Data type for coordinates of local maximums uint32 (default) | double | single | uint8 | uint16

params.name: Output variable size signal
params.values: Support input signals of varying length on (default) | off

params.name: Count output data type
params.values: Data type for number of local maximums uint32 (default) | double | single | uint8 | uint16
